title: Government of India Act 1935 (Original Text)
seoTitle: Government of India Act 1935 - Official Text
seoDescription: Official UK legislation text for the 1935 constitutional framework behind Bengal provincial autonomy and the 1937 election.
note: Official statutory text for the constitutional framework that introduced provincial autonomy and shaped the 1937 Bengal election.
whyItMatters: It supplies the primary legal framework for interpreting Bengal provincial autonomy, electorate design, and coalition politics after 1937.
